newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end sharply up, helped by Wall Street.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end sharply up, helped by Wall Street.

text.p: Tokyo stocks ended sharply higher on Tuesday, as Wall Street's recent surge encouraged investors to buy Japanese shares. But the upside may be limited, as investors will be cautious ahead of Friday, when September options and futures will expire, brokers said.
The key 225-share Nikkei average gained 357.32 points or 1.77 percent to close at 20,559.59. Its December futures added 340 points to 20,570.
"The second day of gains in the New York market prompted investors to bargain-hunt blue-chip issues," said Masaaki Higashida, deputy general manager at Nomura Securities.
